mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.order_name as orderName, u.nick_name as investorName, u.user_id as userId, mi.connect_ip as serverIp, a.id as apikeyId, a.name as apikeyName, o.symbol, CASE a.footplate WHEN 0 THEN '币安' WHEN 1 THEN 'Gate' ELSE '未知' END as exchangeName, o.status, CASE o.status WHEN 0 THEN '启动中' WHEN 1 THEN '运行中' WHEN 2 THEN '暂停' WHEN 3 THEN '已结束' ELSE '未知' END as statusName, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, o.income, o.income_rate as incomeRate, o.annualized_rate as annualizedRate, DATE_FORMAT(o.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime, CONCAT( TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, o.create_time, NOW()), '天', MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.create_time, NOW()), 24), '时', MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, o.create_time, NOW()), 60), '分' ) as runTime, DATEDIFF(IFNULL(o.ent_time, NOW()), o.create_time) as runDays, IFNULL(JSON_EXTRACT(o.param_str, '$.amountObj.TotalAmount'), 0) as investAmount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM w_order_position WHERE order_no = o.order_no AND end_time IS NOT NULL) as tradeCount, op.trade_num as positionNum, op.open_price as positionAvgPrice, op.income as unrealizedPnl, DATE_FORMAT(op.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as positionStartTime, o.strategy_id as strategyId, si.strategy_name as strategyName from w_order_info o left join w_user_info u on u.user_id = o.user_id left join w_apikey_info a on a.id = o.apikey_id left join w_main_info mi on mi.main_no = o.main_no left join w_strategy_info si on si.strategy_id = o.strategy_id left join ( select order_no, trade_num, open_price, income, start_time from w_order_position where end_time is null order by start_time desc limit 1 ) op on op.order_no = o.order_no where o.order_no = #{orderNo} and o.user_id = #{userId}
